svg.title: Lodge conceptual floor plan
svg.desc: Floor plan of Common lodge, north up, cut 1.2 m above the floor. Overall 12.59 by 11.27 m outside the rainscreen; 2 container module(s) of 12.192 by 2.438 m. Rooms with clear dimensions: Shared kitchen 5.48 by 2.27 m (12.5 m²); Pantry and cold storage 1.90 by 2.27 m (4.3 m²); Laundry 1.90 by 2.27 m (4.3 m²); Mechanical and battery room 2.37 by 2.27 m (5.4 m²); Gathering hall 11.91 by 6.00 m (71.5 m²); Workshop and tool library 4.43 by 2.27 m (10.1 m²); Washroom with shower 1.90 by 2.27 m (4.3 m²); Universal washroom 2.35 by 2.27 m (5.3 m²); Boot room 2.97 by 2.27 m (6.8 m²). Screened porch on the west side; Covered entry deck on the east side. ramp at 1:15, 9.63 m long; ramp at 1:15, 9.63 m long. Not for construction.

g.text: Floor plan • cut 1.2 m above the floor • conceptual, not for construction
Clear room lengths inside the lining (m)
Walls, openings and zones are diagrammatic. Clear dimensions are measured inside the interior lining.
Finished floor 0.64 m above assumed level grade. At 1:15, every 0.1 m of floor height adds 1.5 m of ramp.
Cut openings in the steel need engineered reinforcement. Accessibility, egress and fire separations need professional review.
